metadata.title: BankSathi India Banking Knowledge Base
metadata.disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Product availability, eligibility, rates and benefits can change; verify with the official source and your bank before applying.

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
entries.summary: A financial-inclusion programme supporting access to a basic savings account, remittance, credit, insurance and pension services.
entries.eligibility: Designed for unbanked individuals; a bank/Bank Mitra verifies KYC and account-opening requirements.
benefits: Basic banking access
No minimum balance requirement for PMJDY accounts
DBT-ready account

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
entries.summary: An annual personal accident insurance scheme linked to a savings bank or post-office account.
entries.eligibility: Generally for account holders aged 18–70; enrolment and auto-debit conditions apply.
benefits: Accidental death/disability cover subject to scheme rules
Low annual premium

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
entries.summary: A renewable one-year life-insurance cover for eligible account holders.
entries.eligibility: Generally available to savings-bank/post-office account holders aged 18–50; scheme conditions apply.
benefits: Life cover subject to terms
Premium collected through account auto-debit

entries.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
entries.summary: A voluntary pension programme for Indian citizens, with contributions based on joining age and selected pension amount.
entries.eligibility: Joining age is 18–40, subject to programme rules and account requirements.
benefits: Regular retirement-income framework
Contribution amount depends on age and chosen option

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
entries.summary: Credit support for eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises through lending institutions.
entries.eligibility: For eligible income-generating non-farm enterprises; lender appraisal and documentation are required.
benefits: Loan categories include Shishu, Kishor and Tarun
Applications are assessed by participating lenders

entries.name: Stand-Up India
entries.summary: Facilitates bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises led by women or SC/ST entrepreneurs.
entries.eligibility: Eligibility, project type, borrower contribution and lending terms are assessed by the bank under scheme rules.
benefits: Support for greenfield enterprise finance
Guidance available through the official portal

entries.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
entries.summary: A small-savings account designed to support long-term savings for an eligible girl child.
entries.eligibility: Opened by parent/legal guardian for an eligible girl child, subject to scheme conditions.
benefits: Long-term disciplined saving
Tax treatment and rate are governed by current rules

entries.name: National Pension System (NPS)
entries.summary: A market-linked retirement savings system regulated by PFRDA.
entries.eligibility: Indian citizens may join subject to age, KYC and current PFRDA rules.
benefits: Choice of pension-fund investment options
Market risk applies; returns are not guaranteed

entries.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
entries.summary: A government-backed long-term small-savings product with rules on deposits, tenure and withdrawals.
entries.eligibility: Resident individuals can open subject to current scheme rules; verify current conditions before investing.
benefits: Long-term saving discipline
Rate and tax treatment are announced under prevailing rules

entries.name: Bank Fixed Deposit (FD)
entries.summary: A bank deposit placed for a fixed tenure at a contracted interest rate.
entries.eligibility: Offered by individual banks subject to KYC, minimum deposit and tenure rules.
benefits: Predictable contracted return if held as agreed
Compare premature-withdrawal terms and deposit insurance

entries.name: Recurring Deposit (RD)
entries.summary: A bank deposit that lets you contribute a fixed amount regularly for a chosen tenure.
entries.eligibility: Bank-specific KYC, deposit amount and tenure rules apply.
benefits: Useful for recurring savings discipline
Interest and premature-closure terms vary by bank

entries.name: Deposit Insurance (DICGC)
entries.summary: DICGC insures eligible deposits with insured banks, subject to statutory terms and limits.
entries.eligibility: Coverage is per depositor per bank in the same right and capacity; deposits across branches of one bank are aggregated.
benefits: Coverage includes principal and interest up to the applicable limit
Current published maximum is ₹5 lakh

entries.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
entries.summary: A grievance-redress mechanism for complaints against regulated entities after approaching the entity first.
entries.eligibility: Follow the bank/NBFC's complaint process first and check the RBI scheme’s grounds and timelines.
benefits: One portal for eligible complaints
No fee for filing a complaint

entries.name: Digital Banking Safety
entries.summary: Guidance for safe digital banking and rapid reporting of unauthorised transactions.
benefits: Never share OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords
Contact the bank immediately and report cybercrime through official channels

entries.name: Education Loan
entries.summary: A loan for eligible higher-education expenses offered under a bank's loan policy; some cases may fit government interest-support programmes.
entries.eligibility: Institution, course, co-borrower, credit and documentation are assessed by the lender.
benefits: May cover permitted education expenses
Compare interest, moratorium, collateral and repayment carefully

entries.name: Home Loan
entries.summary: A secured loan for buying, building or improving a residential property.
entries.eligibility: Lender assesses income, credit history, property documents, repayment capacity and other criteria.
benefits: Long repayment tenures may reduce EMI but increase total interest
Compare APR, fees, reset terms and prepayment rules

entries.name: Personal Loan
entries.summary: An unsecured consumer loan offered subject to lender underwriting.
entries.eligibility: Income, credit score, existing obligations and lender policy affect approval and pricing.
benefits: No collateral in many products
Usually costs more than secured loans; compare total cost and charges

entries.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
entries.summary: A credit facility intended to support eligible farmers’ cultivation and related credit needs.
entries.eligibility: Land/cultivation status, scale of finance and bank assessment determine eligibility.
benefits: Flexible crop-credit framework
Ask the bank about current interest-subvention and repayment rules
